objective: Gate6 E2E real development-only: build/navegacion, JWT SQL auth, RBAC allow/deny, activacion fail-closed, persona, vinculo tipado, documento, version, kardex, vencimiento, alerta y cleanup/restauracion. Datos temporales por run id. No Produccion.

actions.content:
name: Catalogo Ampliado Gate6 E2E Development
on:
  push:
    branches: [Edarsahub_Desarrollo]
    paths: [ops/e2e/requests/CATALOGO-AMPLIADO-GATE6-20260908.execute]
permissions: {contents: read}
jobs:
  e2e:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: development
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      EDARSAHUB_SQL_HOST: '54.39.104.176'
      EDARSAHUB_SQL_PORT: '1433'
      EDARSAHUB_SQL_DATABASE: 'EDARSAHUB'
      EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER: HRLectura
      EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD }}
      JWT_SECRET: gate6-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.sha }}
      ENV: development
      GATE6_EVIDENCE_FILE: ${{ runner.temp }}/gate6/evidence.json
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with: {python-version: '3.11'}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: {node-version: '20'}
      - run: python -m pip install fastapi httpx pymssql pydantic python-dotenv email-validator bcrypt PyJWT
      - name: Navigation and frontend build
        run: npm ci --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend && grep -Rqs 'Catalogo Ampliado' frontend/build/static/js && grep -q 'path="catalogo-ampliado"' frontend/src/App.js
      - name: Real API SQL E2E
        env: {PYTHONPATH: '${{ github.workspace }}/backend'}
        run: mkdir -p "$(dirname "$GATE6_EVIDENCE_FILE")" && python backend/tools/catalogo_ampliado_gate6_e2e.py
      - name: Manifest
        if: always()
        run: mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/gate6"; printf '%s\n' "run=$GITHUB_RUN_ID" "commit=$GITHUB_SHA" 'production_touched=false' > "$RUNNER_TEMP/gate6/manifest.txt"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with: {name: 'catalogo-ampliado-gate6-${{ github.run_id }}', path: '${{ runner.temp }}/gate6', if-no-files-found: error, retention-days: 30}

from pathlib import Path
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
def t(p): return (R/p).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
def test_gate6_contract():
 w=t('.github/workflows/catalogo-ampliado-gate6-e2e.yml'); s=t('backend/tools/catalogo_ampliado_gate6_e2e.py')
 assert 'Edarsahub_Desarrollo' in w and 'environment: development' in w and 'production_touched=false' in w
 assert 'create_token' in s and 'NivelJerarquia>=80' in s and 'NivelJerarquia<80' in s
 for x in ('personas','vinculos','documentos','versiones','kardex','vencimientos','alertas/reglas'): assert x in s
 assert 'finally:' in s and 'DELETE FROM dbo.Gobierno_' in s and 'Edarsahub_Produccion' not in s and 'SUPERADMIN' not in s
